data.body: MQ-4 implemented behind dso.merge_queue.enabled (default OFF) per opus-reviewed design, split into 2 increments landed via the still-active two-tier flow: PR-A (wait-for-pr.sh merge-queue terminal-state handling — commit 10b717c9e1, on main via PR #579) and PR-B (flag-gated promotion path in merge-to-main-pr.sh — commit 4cf3b2fe9a, landing via PR #581). PR-B: single early flag read; 3 gated points (merge dispatch flag-ON calls _phase_merge directly session->main; staged-advance block gated to flag-OFF; --resume PR-discovery filter made base==main-aware under MQ); version bump rides _phase_merge pre-push naturally (skip-guard inert on session branch). NO physical deletion of staged machinery / create-sprint-draft-pr retirement — DEFERRED to a post-MQ-6 cleanup story. New test-merge-to-main-mq-path.sh (8/8); flag-OFF byte invariance confirmed via stash-and-rerun. Verified gh exposes mergeStateStatus+autoMergeRequest but no queue-entry field, so terminal detection rests on state+autoMergeRequest+checks (not a non-existent QUEUED enum).
